title: How Much Does a Trip to Sri Lanka Cost? A Practical Budget Guide
searchIntent: Budget planning for travellers estimating the cost of a Sri Lanka holiday
brief: Help travellers understand the main costs of visiting Sri Lanka, including accommodation, food, local transport, private drivers, trains, activities, safaris and beach stays. Compare budget, mid-range and more comfortable travel styles without relying on fixed prices that may quickly become outdated. Explain which parts of a Sri Lanka trip usually affect the budget most and where travellers can save without reducing the quality of their experience.

title: 7 Days in Sri Lanka: The Best One-Week Itinerary for First-Time Visitors
searchIntent: Route planning for travellers who have approximately one week to explore Sri Lanka
brief: Create a realistic seven-day Sri Lanka route for travellers with limited time. Focus on choosing a manageable combination of heritage, hill country, wildlife and coast rather than trying to see the entire island. Explain what travellers may need to skip, how travel days affect the itinerary and offer alternative routes for culture-focused, wildlife-focused and beach-focused visitors.

title: Sri Lanka Honeymoon Guide: Romantic Places, Beaches and Experiences
searchIntent: Trip inspiration and itinerary planning for couples considering Sri Lanka for a honeymoon
brief: Build a romantic Sri Lanka travel guide covering hill-country stays, scenic train journeys, quiet beaches, wildlife experiences, heritage locations and slower travel. Suggest combinations such as Sigiriya, Kandy, Ella, the south coast and Galle while explaining how couples can avoid spending too much of their honeymoon moving between hotels. Include ideas for different honeymoon styles without recommending specific hotels unless verified.

title: Sri Lanka East Coast Travel Guide: Trincomalee, Nilaveli, Arugam Bay and More
searchIntent: Seasonal destination planning for travellers considering Sri Lanka's east coast
brief: Create a complete introduction to travelling along Sri Lanka's east coast, including Trincomalee, Nilaveli, Pasikuda, Kalkudah and Arugam Bay. Explain beaches, surfing, snorkelling, wildlife and cultural experiences while carefully discussing seasonal conditions. Help travellers decide when the east coast makes more sense than the south coast and suggest ways to connect it with the Cultural Triangle.

title: Getting Around Sri Lanka: Trains, Buses, Tuk-Tuks, Taxis and Private Drivers
searchIntent: Transport planning for international travellers deciding how to travel around Sri Lanka
brief: Compare the main ways travellers can move around Sri Lanka, including trains, public buses, tuk-tuks, taxis, ride-hailing services and private drivers. Explain the advantages and disadvantages of each option, luggage considerations, comfort, flexibility and realistic travel-day planning. Avoid quoting live fares or schedules and encourage travellers to verify current transport information before travelling.

title: Sigiriya vs Pidurangala: Which Rock Should You Climb?
searchIntent: Comparison for travellers deciding whether to climb Sigiriya, Pidurangala or both
brief: Compare Sigiriya Rock Fortress and Pidurangala from a traveller's perspective. Discuss scenery, heritage value, hiking difficulty, photography, sunrise experiences, time requirements and the advantages of visiting both. Make clear that Sigiriya is an important archaeological and cultural site while Pidurangala offers a different hiking and viewpoint experience. Avoid relying on changeable ticket prices or opening times.

title: Yala vs Udawalawe: Which Sri Lanka Safari Is Better for You?
searchIntent: Safari comparison for travellers deciding which Sri Lankan national park to include in their itinerary
brief: Compare Yala and Udawalawe for first-time visitors based on wildlife experiences, landscapes, elephant viewing opportunities, leopard expectations, crowd levels, route planning and overall safari style. Never guarantee animal sightings. Include responsible wildlife guidance and explain how each park fits into common routes between Ella and Sri Lanka's southern coast.

title: Sri Lanka with Kids: A Practical Family Travel Guide
searchIntent: Family trip planning for parents considering a holiday in Sri Lanka
brief: Help families plan a comfortable Sri Lanka trip with realistic travel times, child-friendly beaches, wildlife experiences, cultural attractions and hill-country stops. Discuss heat, long road journeys, food, luggage, rest days, wildlife safety and choosing a slower itinerary. Suggest destinations suitable for different age groups without making unsupported safety guarantees.

title: Sri Lanka South Coast Road Trip: Galle, Unawatuna, Mirissa, Weligama and Tangalle
searchIntent: Coastal itinerary planning for travellers exploring southern Sri Lanka
brief: Create a flexible south-coast route connecting Galle, Unawatuna, Weligama, Mirissa, Hiriketiya and Tangalle. Explain which places suit surfing, swimming, nightlife, couples, families and quieter beach stays. Show travellers why staying longer in fewer beach towns can produce a better trip than changing hotels every day. Discuss seasonal sea and weather conditions without guaranteeing them.

title: 15 Hidden Gems in Sri Lanka Beyond the Usual Tourist Route
searchIntent: Destination discovery for travellers looking for less obvious places beyond Sri Lanka's major attractions
brief: Introduce lesser-known places and experiences beyond the classic Sigiriya, Kandy, Ella, Yala and Mirissa route. Consider locations such as Jaffna, Kalpitiya, Knuckles Mountain Range, Haputale, Belihuloya, Gal Oya, Delft Island, Mannar, Ritigala, Madulsima and quieter east-coast destinations. Focus on why each place may suit particular travellers and encourage responsible exploration rather than presenting them simply as undiscovered tourist attractions.
